answer: A maturation timelock stops bulk fakes. Newcomers lock 70 credits on a garden plot in the karst ledger. Weight starts at 5%, rising 5% an epoch to its zenith at epoch 20; early exit forfeits the bond. Miss one epoch's fresh proof and maturation resets to zero. First 30, k-th 30+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000, with 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. A rented-maturity ring fails: one key files one proof. Honest agents pay 30 once and mature.
